title: WAF · ModSecurity / Coraza
description: Атаки на веб по данным WAF: категории CRS, адреса, хосты, что заблокировано и что дошло до приложения.

panels.title: Атаки за период
panels.sql: SELECT count() AS `атак`, countIf(outcome = 'deny') AS `заблокировано`, countIf(outcome = 'allow') AS `пропущено`, uniqExact(src_ip) AS `адресов` FROM events WHERE source_class = 'waf' AND action = 'http.attack' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Хосты под атакой
panels.sql: SELECT uniqExact(node) AS `хостов`, uniqExactIf(node, attrs['engine_mode'] = 'DetectionOnly') AS `хостов_в_режиме_детекта`, countIf(toUInt16OrZero(attrs['status']) >= 500) AS `ответов_5xx` FROM events WHERE source_class = 'waf' AND action = 'http.attack' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Атаки по времени и категории CRS
panels.sql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS t, attrs['category'] AS category, count() AS n FROM events WHERE source_class = 'waf' AND action = 'http.attack' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY t, category ORDER BY t

panels.title: Адреса-источники
panels.sql: SELECT src_ip AS `адрес`, count() AS `атак` FROM events WHERE source_class = 'waf' AND action = 'http.attack' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY `адрес` ORDER BY `атак` DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Цели: хост и путь
panels.sql: SELECT node AS `хост`, object AS `запрос`, count() AS `атак`, uniqExact(src_ip) AS `адресов` FROM events WHERE source_class = 'waf' AND action = 'http.attack' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY `хост`, `запрос` ORDER BY `атак` DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Дошло до приложения: детект без блокировки
panels.sql: SELECT toString(ts) AS `время`, src_ip AS `адрес`, node AS `хост`, object AS `запрос`, attrs['category'] AS `категория`, attrs['status'] AS `ответ`, attrs['rule_ids'] AS `правила` FROM events WHERE source_class = 'waf' AND action = 'http.attack' AND outcome = 'allow' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Реагирование: блокировки и симуляции
panels.sql: SELECT toString(ts) AS `время`, mode AS `режим`, if(dry_run = 1 OR mode = 'simulate', 'симуляция', 'реально') AS `тип`, ip AS `адрес`, incident_id AS `инцидент`, executor AS `исполнитель`, if(ok = 1, 'ok', 'ошибка') AS `итог`, detail AS `детали` FROM response_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
